title: Fit an OpenAI request to a product contract
description: Choose a task, model tier, retrieval breadth, output budget, and delivery mode. The model exposes quality, context, latency, and relative cost as coupled decisions.

tasks.label: Support ticket extraction
tasks.detail: Return a small strict object from one bounded user message.

tasks.label: Grounded policy answer
tasks.detail: Answer from current, access-filtered policy evidence with citations.

tasks.label: Incident analysis
tasks.detail: Compare logs and runbook evidence, then propose a bounded diagnosis.

modelTiers.label: Small general model
modelTiers.detail: Lowest modeled latency and cost for bounded tasks that pass evaluation.

modelTiers.label: Strong general model
modelTiers.detail: More capability for ambiguity, multimodal input, and instruction following.

modelTiers.label: Reasoning model
modelTiers.detail: Best modeled quality for multi-step analysis with a larger latency budget.
